_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "avatar_media_id" TEXT NULL, "home_area_id" TEXT NULL, "default_visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "rack_visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "grade_prefs" TEXT NULL, "theme" TEXT NOT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "quiet_hours" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "areas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NULL, "ascii_key" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "altitude_m" INTEGER NULL, "rock_type" TEXT NULL, "aspect" TEXT NULL, "approach_min" INTEGER NULL, "location_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("location_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "access_notes" TEXT NULL, "merged_into_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gym_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "grading" TEXT NOT NULL, "route_expiry_weeks" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gym_walls" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "gym_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "height_m" REAL NULL, "angle" TEXT NULL, "angle_deg" INTEGER NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_reset_on" TEXT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gym_colour_grades" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "gym_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "colour_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "boulder_min_score" REAL NULL, "boulder_max_score" REAL NULL, "route_min_score" REAL NULL, "route_max_score" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NULL, "ascii_key" TEXT NULL, "area_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "discipline" TEXT NOT NULL, "pitch_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "length_m" REAL NULL, "angle" TEXT NULL, "protection" TEXT NULL, "descent" TEXT NULL, "rope_length_m" INTEGER NULL, "rope_type" TEXT NULL, "water_depth_m" REAL NULL, "tide_dependent" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("tide_dependent" IN (0, 1)), "season_notes" TEXT NULL, "first_ascent" TEXT NULL, "first_ascent_year" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "consensus_score" REAL NULL, "quality_avg" REAL NULL, "gym_wall_id" TEXT NULL, "gym_colour_grade_id" TEXT NULL, "set_on" TEXT NULL, "expires_on" TEXT NULL, "setter_note" TEXT NULL, "merged_into_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pitches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "length_m" REAL NULL, "angle" TEXT NULL, "protection" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "anchor" TEXT NULL, "belay_notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "grade_systems" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grade_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "grades" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "system_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL, "score" REAL NULL, "score_low" REAL NULL, "score_high" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "route_grades" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pitch_id" TEXT NULL, "grade_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "grade_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attribute_defs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_keys" TEXT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "route_attributes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "attribute_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "topos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NULL, "area_id" TEXT NULL, "media_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trips" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "area_id" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trip_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "guest_name" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "climb_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "trip_id" TEXT NULL, "climb_group_id" TEXT NULL, "area_id" TEXT NULL, "setting" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_at" TEXT NULL, "end_at" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "location_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("location_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "default_shoe_id" TEXT NULL, "elevation_gain_m" INTEGER NULL, "conditions" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weather_snapshots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "temp_c" REAL NULL, "precip_mm" REAL NULL, "wind_ms" REAL NULL, "humidity_pct" REAL NULL, "cloud_pct" REAL NULL, "water_temp_c" REAL NULL, "raw" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "guest_name" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "invited_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ascents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ascent_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "style" TEXT NOT NULL, "tries" INTEGER NOT NULL, "falls" INTEGER NULL, "rests" INTEGER NULL, "high_point" TEXT NULL, "feel" TEXT NULL, "personal_grade_id" TEXT NULL, "official_grade_id" TEXT NULL, "difficulty_score" REAL NULL, "quality_stars" INTEGER NULL, "duration_s" INTEGER NULL, "shoe_id" TEXT NULL, "setting" TEXT NOT NULL, "discipline" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ascent_beta" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ascent_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "beta_notes" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ascent_pitches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "ascent_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pitch_id" TEXT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "leader" TEXT NOT NULL, "leader_member_id" TEXT NULL, "style" TEXT NULL, "falls" INTEGER NULL, "rests" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ascent_attributes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "ascent_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "attribute_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ascent_gear" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "ascent_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "gear_piece_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "borrowed_from" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NULL, "ascent_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_path" TEXT NULL, "thumb_path" TEXT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "duration_s" REAL NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL, "upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "share_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "credited_to" TEXT NULL, "exif_stripped" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("exif_stripped" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gear_models" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "brand" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_label" TEXT NULL, "colour_hex" TEXT NULL, "specs" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gear_pieces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "colour_hex" TEXT NULL, "serial" TEXT NULL, "made_on" TEXT NULL, "bought_on" TEXT NULL, "reslung_on" TEXT NULL, "resling_interval_months" INTEGER NULL, "retire_after_months" INTEGER NULL, "remind" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("remind" IN (0, 1)), "in_default_rack" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("in_default_rack" IN (0, 1)), "specs" TEXT NULL, "retired_on" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gear_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "piece_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shoes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_label" TEXT NULL, "colour_hex" TEXT NULL, "closure" TEXT NULL, "default_for" TEXT NULL, "bought_on" TEXT NULL, "resole_after_days" INTEGER NULL, "retired_on" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shoe_resoles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shoe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ticklist_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "done_ascent_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "route_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "high_point" TEXT NULL, "beta_notes" TEXT NULL, "sent_ascent_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target" TEXT NOT NULL, "deadline" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "achieved_on" TEXT NULL, "source_gap" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "benchmark_defs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "higher_is_better" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("higher_is_better" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "benchmark_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "benchmark_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "performed_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "bodyweight_kg" REAL NULL, "added_kg" REAL NULL, "edge_mm" REAL NULL, "grip" TEXT NULL, "duration_s" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX areas_parent ON areas (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX areas_country ON areas (country_code)
CREATE INDEX routes_area ON routes (area_id)
CREATE INDEX route_grades_route ON route_grades (route_id)
CREATE INDEX route_attributes_key_value ON route_attributes (attribute_key, value)
CREATE INDEX sessions_owner_date ON sessions (owner_id, local_date)
CREATE INDEX session_members_user_status ON session_members (user_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ascents_owner_setting_discipline ON ascents (owner_id, setting, discipline)
CREATE INDEX ascents_owner_route ON ascents (owner_id, route_id)
CREATE INDEX ascents_session ON ascents (session_id)
CREATE INDEX ascent_attributes_key_value ON ascent_attributes (attribute_key, value)
CREATE INDEX media_session ON media (session_id)
